notes.title: Cardseer is a part of Deckbuilders Fest 2024!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello again everyone![/b]

We have some exciting news for all the Cardseer fans and curious players out there! We are delighted to announce that we will be taking part in the Deckbuilders Fest 2024! To celebrate the occasion, we will be releasing an update for you all to enjoy. We will announce the full details of the update when it is released on the 25th of March.

Till next time,
The Aventia Entertainment Team

notes.title: What's next for Cardseer?
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! It’s been a while. Sorry. We missed you after NextFest![/b]

We were overjoyed to hear from the vast number of you that thoroughly enjoyed the demo. The Aventia Entertainment team has faced some challenges over the last 9 months. We appreciate all your feedback, and please know we have made note of all your points and have been implementing changes. We have been continuing working towards the full game release and we wanted to tell you guys about what we’ve been up to.

[b]Campaign Updates[/b]

We have been hard at work on continuing the Campaign past the Vanguard chapter, including creating the new maps, enemies and stories for the Elementalist, Agent and Occultist. We are excited to show you their stories over the coming months in future devlogs. For now, we’ll give you a sneak peak of an improved map from the Vanguard campaign!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41737251/475f0ff6450decf663e3921b77e29eebad41d70a.png[/img]

We’d like to present below a region of the world defined by a portion of the Orindoth Empire and Drothmund. The Orindoth Empire, founded by the steadfast warrior Orin and later expanded by his descendants Talin and Alin, is located in a prosperous region of the world and has been bordered by the small tribes of the Drothmund people for centuries. With recent construction of the city Alindoth closer to the Drothmund border, tensions have grown between both factions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41737251/62ecd300d809c07fd280704bb55d7cf29eb5c045.jpg[/img]

We’re happy with these new improvements to the game art, we believe these updates make the world of Cardseer feel more alive. Further additions and improvements such as more music and SFX (highlighted through feedback from our NextFest demo players) will also be addressed. We hope this will bolster your experience and immersion in the lore of the Campaign. 

[b]Gameplay Updates[/b]

We are always looking for interesting mechanics and ideas to add to Cardseer to improve variety and replayability, and one exciting new addition is Perk trees! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41737251/93005997d72e91711887c6c2f156f4b32178d8eb.png[/img]

We have been hard at work implementing Perks for each of the playable heroes that offer unique builds for your playthroughs. This will provide a fun and unique experience each time you play, with multiple ways to combine your choices of perks, relics and cards.

We are excited to continue further work and improvements to Cardseer, and bring you the full experience in 2024.

Till next time,
The Aventia Entertainment Team

notes.title: v1.05c patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thanks for playing and also for reporting the bugs you have found, we are only human and we do our best but some bugs do manage to slip through despite our best efforts. We have made some fixes and improvements in the last few days, which include:

[list]
[*] There was a nasty bug where the game appeared to randomly crash during battles due to a bizarre interaction with legacy code in a text display extension, we have updated everything and disabled legacy code so *hopefully* this is solved. Apologies if you were affected by this!
[*] Fixing Snake defensive animation
[*] Fixed bug with Counter Attack artifact
[*] Fixed card alpha when picking a card extremely quickly after a battle
[*] Fixed rare crash when enemy took damage with no cards in buffer
[*] Improved some dialogue
[*] Fixed unnecessary delay with Resolute artifact animation
[*] Fixed potion tooltip position in shop
[*] Fixed enemy move tooltips not updating when stunned from certain cards
[/list]

notes.title: Demo v1.05 Release! Animations, New Campaign, Balance and Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have just released the huge 1.05 update for the Cardseer demo. We have rewritten large portions of the game essentially from scratch for improved stability, performance and features, along with an overhauled cadmpaign and graphical improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41737251/983794148e33b6611c4486e744bc625a8792afca.gif[/img]

This update includes:
[list]
[*] Animated characters
[*] Completely new Vanguard campaign, including 4 regions
[*] Improved Gauntlet and Campaign maps, more variety of Gauntlet maps
[*] Rebalanced cards and improved card/tooltip text
[*] More powerful artifacts to discover
[*] Much more to discover for yourself
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41737251/3e025667954c04f0b801e4a8faf6b8cd1604a60c.gif[/img]

This is also a good time to announce that we will be participating in the Steam October Next Fest (starting on the 3rd of October), so if you want to support Cardseer's development make sure to wishlist and share the game with your friends!

Until next time,
Aventia Entertainment

notes.title: Demo Update v1.0.4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41737251/93b8fbb6a3eddb4a395ddd75aa9d790b8901193a.png[/img]
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We have just released version 1.0.4 for the Aventia Demo, or should I say, Cardseer Demo. As you may have noticed, we have decided to change the name of the game from Aventia to Cardseer. We believe the new name is more appropriate and fitting to the game, and we hope the change doesn’t cause too much confusion. The update also includes:
[list]
[*]Overhaul to card text: You will find the card text to be more verbose and easily understandable, with less cryptic keywords.
[*]Added status icons for some hero power effects, replacing the additional temporary text from cards
[*]Improved tutorial graphics
[*]Swapped the art for Honed Claw and Sharpened Claw
[*]Adjusting position for many menu UI elements
[*]General UI text and font improvements
[*]General Bug Fixes
[/list]

V1.0.4a HOTFIX:

[list]
[*]Fixing bug with power card tooltips
[/list]

Have Fun!

EDIT: There may be some hiccups with the demo installation if you have played prior to patch 1.0.4. If the game won't start for you, try reinstalling and that should do the trick. If you haven't downloaded the demo before this patch you should be unaffected.

notes.title: Demo v1.0.3 Release - Balance and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41737251/e01c05273c5d2f8fc76ff966530944c79214e374.gif[/img]

Misc Changes:

-	Added XP bars to class selection screen in Gauntlet
-	Compounding Amulet text changed to “Burn deals 100% of Damage”
-	Fixed volume sliders not updating in pause settings menu
-	Status icons now drop down to lower levels instead of extending beyond the health bar
-	Limitless now reduces all cards in hand’s cost by X for that turn rather than set their cost to 0
-	Combo from relics now counts towards combo count for the turn
-	Fixed memory leak issue with tutorial
-	Fixed Psychic Horror being unable to be upgraded
-	Escape key now works properly in deck viewing screen
-	Card text on “Sold” cards now centered properly
-	Hero Powers are now shown on the main battle UI
-	Preview of created cards now show above a card when you hover over it
-	Fixed Summon: Wisdom tooltip text overrunning in deck viewing screen
-	Updated tutorial for new power selection mode
-	Fixed bug with Counter Attack activating when the player is Defiant

Card Changes:

ELEMENTALIST
-	Meteor Storm damage reduced from 8 to 7
-	Inner Flame changed to “Limitless 2”
-	Ice Ball and Ice Barrage damage reduced from 4 to 3
-	Snowfall damage reduced to 8, Snowstorm damage reduced to 10
-	Boiling Magma and Blazing Magma damage reduced from 6 to 5
VANGUARD
-	Forge now creates both 1 Strike and 1 Block
-	Cast now creates 1 Just Strike and 1 Strong Block
-	Peaceful Vibes and Serene Vibes Atrophy changed to Atrophy to all
-	Steel Breastplate shield increased from 7 to 8, Steel Cuirass shield increased from 10 to 11
-	Sacred Light damage increased from 4 to 6, Sacred Fire damage increased from 7 to 9
-	Suit Up reworked Cost: 1, Double your shield, Armour Up reworked Cost: 1 Triple your shield 
AGENT
-	Bombs Changed to Damage all 16 Sacrifice 4, Bombs Away Changed to Damage all 20 Sacrifice 4
OCCULTIST
-	Energy Bolt damage reduced from 12 to 11, Chaos Bolt damage reduced from 14 to 13
-	Shadow Raven damage reduced from 8 to 7, Shadow Bat damage reduced from 11 to 10
-	Evil Eye shield reduced from 4 to 3, Evil Gaze shield reduced from 7 to 6
-	Psychic Claw damage reduced from 25 to 23, Umbra Claw damage reduced from 33 to 30
-	The Chasm damage reduced from 19 to 16, The Void damage reduced from 26 to 21

Enemy Changes:

-	Wood Spider: Attack from 4x2 - 4x4 to 3x2 - 3x4
-	Drothmund Brave: HP reduced from 55 to 50
-	Drothmund Charger: HP reduced from 60 to 55, Attack changed to 5-10 and 4x2
-	Drothmund Mage: Attack reduced to 8 - 12
-	Drothmund Assassin: Pierce Attack reduced to 9 - 13
-	Frost Troll: Multiple Attack reduced to 12x2 - 15x2
